formalism.scope: exact contractual cost per activity and BDI category from P16 chains: owned active weeks x tariff + each chain's lifecycle (idle + MOB + DEMOB) pro rata to the active weeks it worked per activity; no persisted cost partitions (#206)

vectors.hand_check: CRANE (EQ) one hire: A owns W01, W02 idle, B owns W03 at 5. Lifecycle = idle 1 x 2 + MOB 30 + DEMOB 30 = 62, worked 1:1 -> 31 each; A EQ 5+31 = 36, B EQ 36. OPER (MO): A owns W01 at 7, no lifecycle.

One hire: A owns W01, W02; W03 idle; B owns W04; active 5, idle 2, MOB 30 + DEMOB 30. Lifecycle 62 split 2:1 -> A 124/3, B 62/3. A EQ 10 + 124/3 = 154/3, B EQ 5 + 62/3 = 77/3; sum 77 = 3 active weeks x 5 + 62 (the pool total). A legacy 50/50 cost partition would give A 41, B 36.
Released and remobilised: hire 1 serves A in W01, hire 2 serves B in W04, no idle. Each hire carries its own MOB 30 + DEMOB 30 = 60: A EQ 5 + 60 = 65, B EQ 65; witness mobility 120.
